verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export feature, but some evidence points to low lock-in. Truss is open source and packages model code, weights, and dependencies to 'run anywhere' across standard frameworks. Model APIs are OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, so clients can be pointed elsewhere, and Switch can route requests back to other providers. Missing for 10: a documented export of all workspace data (checkpoints, weights, logs, usage history) in open formats, explicit download of training checkpoints, account offboarding or deletion docs, and independent corroboration of leaving the platform.
